passMark: A student passes when the yearly average, or the average of subject totals, is 50 or above.
executiveHelp: School performance, active policy, and compliance in one view.
trendsHelp: Pass rate by year, and how many students in each year have marks.
premiumHelp: The next-year pass rate is a straight line from the last two years. The activity log is the record the system already keeps.
forecastShort: Not enough years to draw a line. The latest pass rate is shown.
hubHelp: Choose who should see the message: all school, students, teachers, staff, parents, or one person. Announcements and emergencies also go on the school announcement list. Memos stay in this office.
noStudents: No students in this school yet
noStudentsHelp: Add students first, then you can message one student.
noTeachers: No teachers in this school yet
noTeachersHelp: Register teachers first, then you can message one teacher.
noStaff: No staff in this school yet
noStaffHelp: Register staff first, then you can message one staff member.
title: Title
bulkHelp: Send to all students, all teachers, all staff, parents, the whole school, or one named person.
inboxHelp: Approve or reject a forwarded store request. Clarify asks for more detail. Manual override approves with a written reason, including a request the store has not forwarded.
kpiHelp: Scheduled periods, attendance marks recorded, and grade submission for each teacher.
documentsHelp: A signature records the name, the account, and the time. It is the school's authorization mark on the document.
compareHelp: Pass rate by year, and by grade for the latest year on record.
correlationHelp: Average mark of students in each teacher's assigned subject, grade, and section.
subject: Subject
transferHelp: Library clearance follows open book loans. Store and finance are confirmed here, because those books are not kept per student. The transfer certificate is issued when all three are clear.
atRiskHelp: The score uses 60 percent of how far the average sits below 100, and 40 percent of absences. High starts at 60. Students with no marks and no attendance are left out.
moeHelp: Built from this school's students, marks, and attendance. Excel opens the CSV file. Print uses the Ethiopic font already on this page.
trainingHelp: Sessions for teachers and other staff.
builderHelp: Drag a field into the report, then save and run it for this school.
warningsHelp: Signals drawn from pass rate, absence, mark submission, and the at-risk score.
insightPassDrop: Pass rate fell by {{value}} points from the previous year.
insightGradeBehind: Grade {{grade}} is {{value}} points below the school pass rate.
insightAbsenceHigh: Absence is {{value}} percent of recorded attendance.
insightSubmissionLow: Only {{value}} percent of mark rows are submitted.
insightGenderGap: Female students are {{value}} percent of the latest year.
insightAtRisk: {{value}} students are in the high band.
insightStable: No warning crossed the line for the latest year.
incidentsHelp: Cases that need the principal. Update the status as the case moves.
demographicsHelp: Headcount, gender, registration type, and mark percentiles for each year.
noChart: There is not enough data to draw this chart.
